response: Experts' recommendations for follow-up of patients with new cardiovascular implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) are not always fully implemented in routine clinical practice. While guidelines recommend regular remote monitoring and in-person follow-ups, variations in adherence to these recommendations exist due to factors such as resource constraints, differences in healthcare systems, and variability in clinical practice patterns. As a result, implementation of expert recommendations can be inconsistent, and further efforts are needed to ensure that patients with CIEDs receive optimal care.
